short.q: What does Jwero do for a jewellery shop owner?
short.a: Jwero runs the counter, stock, customers and accounts of a jewellery shop on one set of data. You set the day's metal rate once and every piece reprices. Bills, old gold, schemes and girvi sit in the same system as WhatsApp chats and follow ups, and dashboards show sales, stock and dues whenever you open them, from the store or your phone.

usecases.hook: The gold rate moves before opening and every tag is now wrong.
usecases.does: Set today's rate once and Jwero reprices every piece by weight, purity, making charge and stones, so the counter and the bill agree.
usecases.changes: No more recalculating tags by hand each morning.

usecases.hook: A salesman asks to give a bigger discount than you allow.
usecases.does: Discounts above your limit wait in an approval queue for you, and each approval is logged with who gave it.
usecases.changes: You decide the exceptions, and there is a record of each.

usecases.hook: You are away and want to know how the day is going.
usecases.does: Dashboards show sales, stock and collections from the same data the counter bills on, and a live floor view shows sales as they ring up.
usecases.changes: You know the day's position without calling the shop.

usecases.hook: A customer who walked out last week has not been called back.
usecases.does: The showroom register logs each walk-in, and a rescue list of walk-outs opens WhatsApp with a ready message for staff to send.
usecases.changes: Lost walk-ins get a second chance instead of being forgotten.

faqs.q: Will I have to change how my shop works to use Jwero?
faqs.a: Mostly no. Jwero is built around how jewellers already work: rate based pricing, old gold, schemes, girvi and HUID. You can import your existing stock from Excel, and we help set up rates, making charges and tag formats before you go live.

faqs.q: Can I see what my staff are doing without standing over them?
faqs.a: Yes. You see bills, discounts, approvals and showroom outcomes by salesperson, and every stock movement is logged. What each staff member can open is set by the role you give them, so you choose what they see too.

faqs.q: Does the AI replace my staff?
faqs.a: No. The AI assistant answers routine WhatsApp questions from what you teach it, within limits you set, and everything it does is logged for you to review. Selling, billing and customer relationships still sit with your people; the AI takes repeat questions off their plate.

short.q: What does Jwero do for a jewellery chain owner?
short.a: Jwero puts every branch on one account, one stock record and one customer list. You see sales, stock and collections by branch on dashboards, move pieces between stores with a tracked transfer, run counts per branch, and control discounts through approvals. A customer who buys at one branch is known at every branch, so any salesman can serve her.

usecases.hook: A customer wants a design that only another branch has in stock.
usecases.does: Search stock across branches, then raise a stock transfer that records the piece leaving one store and arriving at the other.
usecases.changes: Pieces move between branches with a record, not a phone call.

usecases.hook: Monday morning, you want last week's numbers for every branch.
usecases.does: Dashboards show sales, stock and collections by branch from the same data the counters bill on, and you can build your own reports.
usecases.changes: You compare branches without waiting for each manager's sheet.

usecases.hook: One branch's count never matches what the books say.
usecases.does: Run a scheduled count per branch, scan the pieces, and Jwero lists what is missing or extra against book stock to be explained.
usecases.changes: Gaps show up branch by branch, with a list to resolve.

usecases.hook: You are opening a new branch next quarter.
usecases.does: Add the branch as a location in the same account with its own stock, counters and staff, and it appears in reports straight away.
usecases.changes: A new store joins the group without a separate setup.

faqs.q: Can I stop branch staff seeing other branches' numbers?
faqs.a: You create roles with the screens and actions each person needs, such as billing only or stock and reports. Very fine branch by branch permission rules are limited today, so we set this up with you at the start.

faqs.q: Will every branch price the same piece the same way?
faqs.a: Yes, if you want it to. Pricing runs from one rate and one set of making charge rules, so the same design is priced the same at every counter unless you set a different rule.

faqs.q: How long will it take my branch staff to learn it?
faqs.a: Billing, tag scanning and customer lookup are on simple counter screens. The training section lets you create courses, enrol staff and issue certifications when they finish, so you can see which branches are ready before you switch over.

short.q: What does Jwero do for a jewellery franchise partner?
short.a: Jwero gives a franchise outlet its own counter, stock and customer records inside the brand's account. You bill at the brand's rate and making rules, receive stock from head office by tracked transfer, use the brand's ready posts and templates, and train your staff on courses head office creates. Head office sees your sales and stock from the same billing.

usecases.hook: Head office sends new stock and you need to check it in.
usecases.does: Stock transfers record what left head office and what arrived at your outlet, piece by piece.
usecases.changes: Disputes about what was sent have a record to settle them.

usecases.hook: A customer asks why your price differs from the brand's other store.
usecases.does: Pricing runs from the brand's rate and making charge rules, so the same design prices the same unless a rule differs.
usecases.changes: You quote with confidence that the price matches the brand.

usecases.hook: Diwali is near and you have no time to design posts.
usecases.does: Head office prepares brand templates and a social calendar that your outlet can use as they are.
usecases.changes: You post on brand without hiring a designer.

usecases.hook: A new salesperson joins and does not know hallmarking rules.
usecases.does: Head office courses are assigned to your staff, who open them from their own learning page, and certifications are issued when they finish.
usecases.changes: New staff learn the brand's way before they face customers.

faqs.q: What can head office see about my outlet?
faqs.a: Head office sees your outlet's sales and stock from the billing you do in Jwero, through the franchise screen and reports. What your staff can open is set by the roles given to them.

faqs.q: Can I set my own discounts?
faqs.a: Discount limits come from the rules set in Jwero. Discounts above the limit wait for approval before the bill goes through, and each approval is logged with who gave it.

faqs.q: Can I use my own WhatsApp number for my customers?
faqs.a: Chats come into a shared inbox per account. Whether you can connect a separate number depends on how the WhatsApp Business accounts are set up, so this is checked with you and head office before you start.

short.q: What does Jwero do for a next generation family member joining the jewellery business?
short.a: Jwero puts the business your family built on clear screens: pricing rules, stock, customers, schemes, girvi and accounts in one place. You can see how the shop really runs, bring in WhatsApp, an online store and marketing, and add structure like roles and approvals without throwing away the way your elders work at the counter.

usecases.hook: Your father keeps the making charges in his head and a diary.
usecases.does: Making charges are set per gram, as a percentage or fixed, by category or design, and prices update with the day's rate.
usecases.changes: The pricing knowledge is written down where the whole team can use it.

usecases.hook: You want to start selling online without upsetting the counter.
usecases.does: Open a Jwero store or connect Shopify or WooCommerce, publishing products from the same stock the counter sells from.
usecases.changes: Online and the shop work from one stock, not two lists.

usecases.hook: Regular customers only come when someone remembers to call them.
usecases.does: Journey recipes send birthday, anniversary and follow up messages automatically once switched on, and RFM reports show who is drifting away.
usecases.changes: Customer relationships no longer depend on one person's memory.

usecases.hook: You want numbers to discuss with the family, not guesses.
usecases.does: Profit and loss, balance sheet, inventory ageing and dashboards come from the shop's own entries.
usecases.changes: Family discussions start from shared figures.

faqs.q: Will the older staff accept new software?
faqs.a: Counter screens are simple: scan a tag, the bill fills in. The old gold, scheme and girvi steps follow how the shop already works. You can begin with billing and stock and switch on more later, so nobody learns everything on day one.

faqs.q: Can I bring in marketing without replacing how my father sells?
faqs.a: Yes. Marketing tools such as journeys, broadcasts and campaigns run alongside the counter. They use the same customer records the shop already builds at billing, so they add reach without changing how the counter sells.

faqs.q: What will my family be able to see?
faqs.a: Owners can see everything; other staff see what their role allows. Dashboards, reports and approvals give everyone in charge the same view of the business, instead of each person keeping their own notes.

short.q: What does Jwero do for a jewellery store manager?
short.a: Jwero gives a store manager one place to run the floor: a live view of sales as they ring up, the showroom register of walk-ins and outcomes, approvals for discounts and attendance corrections, shift open and close with counted cash, and stock counts with a discrepancy list. Your own My Day screen lists what is waiting on you.

usecases.hook: Morning opening, you need to know what is waiting on you today.
usecases.does: My Day lists approvals, tasks, overdue hallmark batches, job work overdue from karigars and inventory waiting on you.
usecases.changes: You start the day with one list, not scattered reminders.

usecases.hook: A salesman's walk-in left without buying and nobody noted why.
usecases.does: The showroom register records each walk-in's outcome and reason, and insights show conversion by salesperson with a daily brief.
usecases.changes: You coach staff from what actually happened on the floor.

usecases.hook: Closing time, the cash drawer and the system must agree.
usecases.does: Close the shift by declaring counted cash; Jwero computes the variance and freezes a Z report for that shift.
usecases.changes: Cash differences show up the same night, on record.

usecases.hook: A staff member forgot to punch in and wants it fixed.
usecases.does: Staff punch in at a store kiosk, and attendance corrections need a manager's approval before they count.
usecases.changes: Attendance changes go through you, with a record.

faqs.q: Will Jwero be used to watch me and my team?
faqs.a: It records work, not people. Bills, approvals, punches and stock movements are logged with who did them, and owners see reports by salesperson and branch. That record also protects you when a figure is questioned.

faqs.q: How long will my staff take to learn it?
faqs.a: The counter screens are simple, and you can assign training courses through the learning section and see who has finished. Most staff only need billing, tag scanning and customer lookup at first.

faqs.q: Can I run a stock count without closing the store?
faqs.a: You schedule counts, staff scan pieces, and differences appear on a separate discrepancy screen to resolve. Counts in progress show on My Day so none are left half done.

short.q: What does Jwero do for a jewellery salesperson?
short.a: Jwero helps a jewellery salesperson serve the customer in front of them. Scan a tag and the price fills in at today's rate. Her history, occasions and past visits show while she is in the store. You can send a catalogue on WhatsApp, give pieces on trial, follow up walk-outs, and see your own incentives and targets on your phone.

usecases.hook: A regular walks in and you cannot remember what she bought.
usecases.does: The visit session shows her history, past visits and items shown, so you pick up where the last salesman left off.
usecases.changes: You greet her like you know her, because you do.

usecases.hook: She likes a necklace but wants her husband to see it first.
usecases.does: Send a catalogue link on WhatsApp of the pieces she liked, and see when she opens it and what she asks about.
usecases.changes: The sale continues after she leaves the shop.

usecases.hook: A walk-in left yesterday saying she would think about it.
usecases.does: The rescue list of walk-outs opens WhatsApp with a ready message for you to send.
usecases.changes: Following up takes one tap, not a remembered phone number.

usecases.hook: Month end, you want to know how close you are to target.
usecases.does: Your own page shows your incentives and targets, and My Day shows what you need per day to close the month.
usecases.changes: You know where you stand without asking the manager.

faqs.q: Will the AI take my job?
faqs.a: No. The AI assistant answers routine WhatsApp questions within limits the owner sets, and hands chats to staff in the inbox. Showing jewellery, building trust and closing the sale stay with you; the AI handles repeat questions like timings.

faqs.q: Will the owner see every customer I bring in?
faqs.a: Yes. Walk-ins, outcomes and sales are recorded against the salesperson, which is also how your conversions and incentives are counted. Customer records belong to the business, so any colleague can serve her when you are away.

faqs.q: Is it hard to learn?
faqs.a: Scan the tag and the bill fills in with weight, purity, rate and making. Customer lookup and catalogues are a few taps. Your manager can also assign short training courses you open from your own learning page.

short.q: What does Jwero do for a jewellery shop cashier?
short.a: Jwero gives the cashier one billing screen. Scan the tag and weight, purity, today's rate, making and GST fill in. Old gold is valued and set off on the same bill, payments split across cash, UPI, EMI and credit notes, loyalty points are earned or redeemed, and each shift opens and closes with counted cash and a Z report.

usecases.hook: A customer pays part cash, part UPI and part by old gold.
usecases.does: Value the old gold at today's rate, set it against the new bill, and split the rest across cash, UPI, EMI or credit note.
usecases.changes: One bill covers it all, without side calculations.

usecases.hook: The internet drops in the middle of a busy Saturday.
usecases.does: Billing keeps working offline and holds bills on the device, syncing once the connection returns.
usecases.changes: The queue keeps moving when the router fails.

usecases.hook: End of shift, you must hand over the drawer.
usecases.does: Close the shift by declaring counted cash; Jwero works out the variance and freezes a Z report.
usecases.changes: Your handover is on record and cannot be quietly changed.

usecases.hook: A customer asks to use her loyalty points on this purchase.
usecases.does: The loyalty card appears while billing so points can be earned or redeemed on that sale.
usecases.changes: Points are applied at the counter, not promised for later.

faqs.q: What if my cash does not match at close?
faqs.a: The close is blind: you declare what you counted and Jwero computes the variance against expected cash. The Z report is frozen, so the record is honest, and the difference can be looked into rather than hidden.

faqs.q: Can I give a discount myself?
faqs.a: Only within the limit set for you. Discounts above that limit wait for a manager's approval before the bill goes through, and the approval is logged with who gave it.

faqs.q: How long does it take to learn billing?
faqs.a: Most of the bill fills itself from the tag scan and today's rate. You learn payments, old gold and shift close, and your manager can assign training courses through the learning section.

short.q: What does Jwero do for a jewellery CRM executive?
short.a: Jwero gives a CRM executive one customer record with purchases, family links, visits, schemes and occasions. A daily occasions list shows who to wish, leads sit on a pipeline by stage, segments and RFM reports find who to contact, and a shared WhatsApp inbox with quick replies and broadcasts lets you reach them, with reports on what happened.

usecases.hook: Every morning you need to know whose birthday or anniversary is today.
usecases.does: The Upcoming Occasions page lists customers' birthdays and anniversaries, and journey recipes can send the wishes automatically.
usecases.changes: Wishes go out on the day, not when someone remembers.

usecases.hook: Enquiries come in from many places and some go cold.
usecases.does: Leads sit on a pipeline board by stage, so each enquiry has an owner and a next step.
usecases.changes: Nothing waits in someone's personal phone.

usecases.hook: The owner asks you to bring back customers who stopped coming.
usecases.does: RFM reports group customers by recency, frequency and value, and segments let you send that group a message.
usecases.changes: You target the right people instead of messaging everyone.

usecases.hook: The same customer appears three times with different numbers.
usecases.does: Find duplicate contacts and merge them into one record.
usecases.changes: One customer, one history, one message.

faqs.q: Will AI do my job?
faqs.a: The AI assistant answers routine WhatsApp questions within rules the owner sets, and every action is logged. Deciding who to contact, writing the offer and handling unhappy customers stay with you. It takes repeat questions off your day.

faqs.q: Will my WhatsApp templates get rejected?
faqs.a: Jwero has starter templates written for WhatsApp's rules, and a builder that flags what is likely to be rejected. Final approval is always WhatsApp's decision, so a rejection can still happen.

faqs.q: Can I see whether my broadcasts worked?
faqs.a: Yes. Broadcast and campaign reports show sends and responses, and you can resend to people who did not respond. Campaign reports also show who bought afterwards.

short.q: What does Jwero do for a jewellery marketing manager?
short.a: Jwero puts a jeweller's marketing next to its customers and sales. Plan festival campaigns on a calendar, build segments, send WhatsApp and email, run automated journeys, schedule social posts through an approval queue, and review Meta and Google ad results and suggested ad ideas. Reports show sends, responses and who bought afterwards.

usecases.hook: Dhanteras is weeks away and the plan lives in a spreadsheet.
usecases.does: A campaign calendar lays out festivals and occasions, with blueprints and templates to start each campaign from.
usecases.changes: You plan ahead with ready starting points.

usecases.hook: Your boosted posts never show whether anyone came in.
usecases.does: Meta and Google campaigns show their results inside Jwero, alongside suggested ad opportunities and learnings from past campaigns.
usecases.changes: Ad results sit next to the customer list, not a separate login.

usecases.hook: Posts go out off brand when the team is rushed.
usecases.does: Brand templates, a content calendar and an approval queue hold posts until they are approved.
usecases.changes: Every post is checked before it goes live.

usecases.hook: Finance asks what last month's campaigns actually brought.
usecases.does: Campaign reports show who received, opened and replied, and which of them bought afterwards.
usecases.changes: You answer with figures from the same system.

faqs.q: Will AI replace the marketing team?
faqs.a: No. Jwero suggests ad ideas and daily social actions, but you review, change and launch them, and posts can be held for approval. Judgement about the brand and the offer stays with you.

faqs.q: Can I test a journey before it messages real customers?
faqs.a: Yes. Journeys can be tested and run through a readiness check before going live, and messages can be set to need approval. Each journey then reports step by step performance and the customers in it, so you see where people drop off.

faqs.q: Do I need a designer for emails?
faqs.a: No. A drag and drop email editor lets you design branded emails, and email can be chosen as a channel when you launch a campaign alongside WhatsApp.

short.q: What does Jwero do for a jewellery ecommerce manager?
short.a: Jwero runs a jeweller's online store from the same stock and prices as the shop. Open a Jwero store with your own design and domain, or connect Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon or Flipkart. Publish products to channels from one screen, see orders and abandoned carts, build landing pages, and use analytics, heatmaps and A/B tests to improve the site.

usecases.hook: A piece sold in the shop is still showing online.
usecases.does: One stock record feeds billing, your store and connected channels, with optional stock push to marketplaces.
usecases.changes: You stop apologising for items that already sold.

usecases.hook: Carts are left full every night and nobody follows up.
usecases.does: Abandoned carts are listed with the customer and items, so you can follow up on WhatsApp or email.
usecases.changes: Abandoned carts become a follow up list.

usecases.hook: A new collection launches and needs its own page.
usecases.does: Build landing pages for collections on your Jwero store without a developer.
usecases.changes: Launch pages go up when you need them.

usecases.hook: You are not sure which banner gets more clicks.
usecases.does: Run an A/B test with two versions and compare, with analytics and heatmaps showing where visitors go.
usecases.changes: Decisions rest on what visitors did.

faqs.q: Can I list on Google Shopping from Jwero?
faqs.a: Not yet. Jwero connects to Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon and Flipkart, but Google Shopping sync is not available today, so listings there are managed outside Jwero.

faqs.q: Do marketplace orders come in automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Once Amazon and Flipkart are connected, their orders come into Jwero as sales orders, and store orders land in one order list with payment and status.

faqs.q: Will the AI chat agent promise customers things I cannot deliver?
faqs.a: You set what the assistant may do alone and what needs approval, teach it from a knowledge base, and every reply is kept in logs. Staff see every conversation in the shared inbox.

short.q: What does Jwero do for a jewellery shop accountant?
short.a: Jwero gives a jeweller's accountant books that come from the bills themselves. GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and input tax credit reconciliation are prepared from sales and purchases. Receivable and payable ageing, party ledgers, day book, metal balances, profit and loss and balance sheet are in the same place, and Jwero connects to Tally and Zoho Books for mapping and checks.

usecases.hook: GST filing is due and the sales register is still being typed.
usecases.does: Jwero prepares GSTR-1 with the B2B and B2C split, GSTR-3B and an input tax credit reconciliation from bills.
usecases.changes: Returns start from billing data, not re-entry.

usecases.hook: The owner asks who owes the shop money and for how long.
usecases.does: Receivable and payable ageing, party ledgers and the day book show who owes you and whom you owe.
usecases.changes: Collection calls start from a clear figure.

usecases.hook: Karigars and suppliers owe gold, not just money.
usecases.does: Metal accounts keep gold balances owed to or by each party alongside money accounts.
usecases.changes: Gold dues are tracked in grams, not in a notebook.

usecases.hook: A big B2B bill needs an e-invoice.
usecases.does: Download the e-invoice JSON for the portal and record the IRN back on the bill.
usecases.changes: The e-invoice reference stays with the bill.

faqs.q: Does Jwero post entries into Tally automatically?
faqs.a: No, not today. Jwero connects to Tally and Zoho Books, maps ledgers, imports masters and checks records against Tally, but entries are not auto posted. Reports and ledgers can be exported for you.

faqs.q: Can Jwero make e-way bills?
faqs.a: Not yet. E-invoice JSON can be downloaded and the IRN recorded back, but e-way bills are made on the government portal for now, outside Jwero.

faqs.q: Will this software replace me?
faqs.a: No. It prepares returns, ledgers and reports from the bills, which removes typing, but checking, filing, judgement on entries and advising the owner stay with you. Approvals queues also keep sensitive changes under review.

short.q: What does Jwero do for a jewellery inventory manager?
short.a: Jwero tracks every tagged jewellery piece on its own, with its location and full movement history. You print barcode tags, run scheduled scan counts with a discrepancy list, record adjustments with reasons, move stock between branches, track pieces on memo, trial or consignment, open and close safes with a count, and see stock value and ageing reports.

usecases.hook: A piece is missing from the tray and nobody knows where it went.
usecases.does: Each tagged piece has its own movement history showing every transfer, memo, trial and sale.
usecases.changes: You trace a piece instead of guessing.

usecases.hook: Month end count, and the tray never matches the book.
usecases.does: Schedule a count, scan pieces, and see missing or extra items on a discrepancy screen to resolve.
usecases.changes: Gaps come as a list, not a feeling.

usecases.hook: Pieces went out on approval and some never came back.
usecases.does: Approval memos and trials record which pieces went out, to whom, and what returned or sold.
usecases.changes: Outstanding pieces are visible by person.

usecases.hook: Old stock is sitting and the owner wants to know its worth.
usecases.does: Inventory reports show stock value and ageing, with today's value against cost.
usecases.changes: You show which pieces to move, with figures.

faqs.q: Does Jwero count raw gold and reconcile it?
faqs.a: Not yet. Jwero shows book balances of metal by party and lot, but a physical metal count and reconciliation screen is not available. Finished pieces are counted by scan; raw metal counts are done outside Jwero for now.

faqs.q: Can I stop people adjusting stock without a reason?
faqs.a: Stock adjustments are recorded with reasons and every movement is logged with who did it. Sensitive actions can be held in approval queues until a manager approves them.

faqs.q: How do I get my existing stock in?
faqs.a: Import from a CSV or Excel sheet, map the columns to jewellery fields like metal, purity, weights and stones, and Jwero creates the products. Tags are then printed from templates.

short.q: What does Jwero do for a jewellery purchase manager?
short.a: Jwero lets a jeweller's purchase manager raise purchase orders, receive goods against them with a quality check before they enter stock, record returns and vendor credits, and keep each supplier's money and metal balance in one ledger. Consignment stock from suppliers is kept apart from your own, and payable ageing shows what you owe.

usecases.hook: A supplier says the full order was sent but some is missing.
usecases.does: Receive goods against the purchase order, with QC on receipt, before anything enters stock.
usecases.changes: Short or faulty supplies are caught at the door.

usecases.hook: Pieces came back from QC and must go back to the vendor.
usecases.does: Record purchase returns and vendor credits linked to the original purchase.
usecases.changes: Credits are tied to the bill they came from.

usecases.hook: You owe a supplier gold and money and the figures differ.
usecases.does: Vendor ledgers show both metal and money balances with each supplier.
usecases.changes: You settle from the same figures the supplier sees.

usecases.hook: A supplier gives stones on consignment.
usecases.does: Consignment agreements keep the supplier's goods separate from your own until they sell.
usecases.changes: Their stock never shows as yours in counts.

faqs.q: Can Jwero tell me what to buy before a festival?
faqs.a: Inventory reports show stock value and ageing, and dashboards show what is selling, which helps you plan. Jwero does not produce a demand forecast today, so the buying decision stays with you.

faqs.q: Can I see what I owe each vendor and since when?
faqs.a: Yes. Payable ageing shows dues by supplier and how old they are, and each vendor's ledger shows money and metal balances, with purchase returns and vendor credits linked to the original purchase.

faqs.q: Who can approve a purchase order?
faqs.a: You decide through roles what each person can do in Jwero, and approval queues can hold sensitive actions until a manager signs off. Very fine permission rules are limited today, so we set them up with you.

short.q: What does Jwero do for a jewellery B2B or wholesale manager?
short.a: Jwero helps a jewellery B2B manager sell to retailers. Send catalogue links and see who opened them and what they asked for, issue pieces on memo and track what comes back or sells, keep metal and money balances per retailer, take stock to exhibitions and back, share designs through the design bank, and see who owes what in ageing reports.

usecases.hook: A retailer asks for your latest designs on WhatsApp.
usecases.does: Send a catalogue link and see which designs they opened and what they asked about.
usecases.changes: You follow up on what they actually looked at.

usecases.hook: Ten retailers hold your pieces on memo and you have lost track.
usecases.does: Memo issue tracks every piece out, back or sold, by retailer.
usecases.changes: Outstanding goods are a list, not a guess.

usecases.hook: You are back from a trade show with a mixed bag.
usecases.does: Exhibition stock is sent out and checked back or sold piece by piece, with show sales recorded against it.
usecases.changes: Anything not sold or returned shows at once.

usecases.hook: A retailer asks for his balance in fine gold.
usecases.does: Party ledgers keep a metal balance and a money balance for each retailer.
usecases.changes: You give the figure in seconds.

faqs.q: Can retailers who use Jwero see my designs directly?
faqs.a: Yes. The design bank shares designs with other organisations under access and price rules you set. Retailers who do not use Jwero can be sent a catalogue link instead.

faqs.q: Does Jwero make e-way bills for my dispatches?
faqs.a: Not yet. E-invoice JSON can be downloaded and the IRN recorded back, but e-way bills are made on the government portal for now, outside Jwero.

faqs.q: Will the owner see my retailer accounts?
faqs.a: Yes. Memos, ledgers and ageing are shared business records, which owners and permitted roles can open. That also means a colleague can cover your accounts when you travel.

short.q: What does Jwero do for a jewellery production manager?
short.a: Jwero gives a jewellery production manager production orders that move through stages, a work in progress view by stage, job work issues of metal and stones to karigars with returns and wastage, a QC station that signs off each stage and finished goods, recovery of scrap and dust, and karigar settlements that bring metal and labour together.

usecases.hook: The owner asks where a customer's order is right now.
usecases.does: Production orders and the work in progress view show each piece's current stage.
usecases.changes: You answer without walking the floor.

usecases.hook: Metal goes to karigars and the returns never quite add up.
usecases.does: Issue metal and stones to karigars as job work, recording returns and wastage against each job.
usecases.changes: Every gram out has a matching record in.

usecases.hook: A batch is finished but you suspect stone setting faults.
usecases.does: The QC station records a verdict on each work order and finished goods receipt, and a failing verdict needs a reason.
usecases.changes: Nothing leaves the floor without a recorded check.

usecases.hook: Dust and filings pile up and their value is unclear.
usecases.does: Recovery records scrap and dust sent for melting and refining, and what came back.
usecases.changes: Recovered metal is accounted for, not lost.

faqs.q: Can Jwero plan bench capacity and promise dates?
faqs.a: Not yet. Stages and work in progress are tracked, but bench capacity planning and promise dates are not built. The work in progress view shows where jobs are piling up.

faqs.q: Can I track stone counts at each setting stage?
faqs.a: Partly. Stones are issued from lots by carat, but per stage stone counts at setting are not tracked yet, so stone loss is checked at finished goods.

faqs.q: Will karigars accept being tracked this way?
faqs.a: Records protect both sides. Each karigar has a running metal account and settlements bring metal, wastage and labour together, so month end starts from shared figures instead of argument.

short.q: What does Jwero do for a karigar or goldsmith working with a jeweller?
short.a: Jwero keeps a karigar's account with the jeweller clear. Metal and stones issued for each job are recorded, with what you return and the wastage, in a running metal account. Settlements bring metal, wastage and labour together, and TDS on labour payments is recorded. In the workshop, you scan a piece, weigh it and record only your own stage.

usecases.hook: The jeweller says you still owe gold from last month.
usecases.does: Your running metal account shows every issue, return and wastage against each job.
usecases.changes: The balance is a shared record, not your word against theirs.

usecases.hook: A piece arrives at your bench from the previous stage.
usecases.does: Scan it at the workstation, see the earlier stage's details, weigh it and record your output only.
usecases.changes: You type one thing: your own work.

usecases.hook: Month end, you want your labour and metal settled.
usecases.does: Settlements bring together metal issued, returned, wastage and labour for each karigar.
usecases.changes: Settlement starts from the same figures on both sides.

usecases.hook: You want to know how much tax was deducted from your labour.
usecases.does: The jeweller records TDS on labour payments on a karigar TDS screen.
usecases.changes: Deductions are on record when you need them.

faqs.q: Do I need to learn software to work with a jeweller on Jwero?
faqs.a: Not much. The jeweller's team records issues and returns. On the workshop floor station, you scan a piece, weigh it and record your stage, and the screen shows the rest.

faqs.q: Can the jeweller see my wastage?
faqs.a: Yes. Wastage is recorded against each job and shows in your metal account and settlement. That same record is what you point to when a figure is disputed.

faqs.q: Is there a karigar app on my own phone?
faqs.a: Jwero is used by the jeweller and their workshop staff. We do not offer a separate app for outside karigars today. Your account is kept by the jeweller and settled with you from those records.

short.q: What does Jwero do for a jewellery CAD designer?
short.a: Jwero helps a CAD designer get designs in front of buyers and into production. The design bank shares designs with other organisations under access and price rules you set, analytics show which designs are viewed and adopted, quotes list a design with metal, weight and making, and bills of material and routings set what each design needs to be made.

usecases.hook: A retailer asks to see your new ring designs.
usecases.does: Share designs through the design bank under access and price rules you set, or send a catalogue link.
usecases.changes: You control who sees each design and at what price.

usecases.hook: You do not know which of your designs buyers actually like.
usecases.does: Design bank analytics show which designs clients view and adopt.
usecases.changes: You design more of what sells.

usecases.hook: A customer wants a price for a design before you start.
usecases.does: Build a quote with metal, weight and making, and share it as a link.
usecases.changes: Pricing talks start from a clear quote.

usecases.hook: Production keeps asking what metal and stones a design needs.
usecases.does: Bills of material and routings set the metal, stones and stages for each design.
usecases.changes: Your design reaches the floor with its recipe attached.

faqs.q: Can I store CAD files in Jwero?
faqs.a: Not yet. Designs carry a reference, but CAD file storage with version history is not built. Keep CAD files in your current storage and note the reference on the design in Jwero.

faqs.q: Can customers approve designs inside Jwero?
faqs.a: Not yet. A separate design approval stage is not available, so approvals happen outside Jwero and the production order starts once the design is final.

faqs.q: Will AI design jewellery and replace CAD work?
faqs.a: Jwero does not generate CAD designs. Its tools help you share, price and track the designs you make, and see which ones buyers adopt. The design skill and judgement stay with you.

short.q: What does Jwero do for a jewellery quality and hallmarking staff member?
short.a: Jwero gives quality and hallmarking staff a hallmarking screen that tracks batches sent and returned, with the HUID recorded on each piece and printed on tags and bills. Goods received from suppliers pass QC before entering stock, and the manufacturing QC station records a verdict on each stage and finished batch, with a reason required for every fail.

usecases.hook: A batch went for hallmarking and nobody knows if it is back.
usecases.does: The hallmarking screen tracks batches sent and returned, and overdue batches show on the manager's My Day.
usecases.changes: Late batches are flagged, not discovered.

usecases.hook: A customer asks for the HUID on her bangle.
usecases.does: Each piece carries its HUID, shown on the piece record and printed on the tag and bill.
usecases.changes: You answer from the record, not a register.

usecases.hook: A supplier delivery has pieces below the stated purity.
usecases.does: Goods received against a purchase order go through QC on receipt before they enter stock.
usecases.changes: Faulty supplies stop at the door.

usecases.hook: A finished batch arrives from the workshop for sign off.
usecases.does: The QC station records a verdict per work order with no preselected outcome, and a fail must carry a reason.
usecases.changes: Every pass or fail is a considered, recorded decision.

faqs.q: Can I pass a whole batch with one click?
faqs.a: No, by design. Verdicts are recorded one work order at a time through a dialog with no preselected outcome, and a failing verdict must carry a reason.

faqs.q: Does Jwero fetch HUID or certificates automatically?
faqs.a: No. You record the HUID and certificate details against each piece or stone, and Jwero then shows and searches them. It does not pull data from the hallmarking centre or labs.

faqs.q: Will the owner see who passed a faulty piece?
faqs.a: Yes. QC verdicts and their reasons are recorded against the work order, so the owner can see who decided what. The same record shows every time you failed a piece and why, which protects your judgement.
